instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Real estate developer specializing in urban residential projects including mid-rise apartment buildings and townhouse communities. Current pipeline of 350 units across 4 active projects. Evaluating modular construction methods and BIM-based cost estimation to reduce construction timelines. A tight-knit operation where everyone wears multiple hats. We have no dedicated innovation budget — improvements happen opportunistically when the team identifies a clear bottleneck affecting our core operations or customer experience.
answers.pastInitiatives: We experimented with a customer self-service portal two years ago after seeing competitors offer similar functionality. We built an MVP with an external agency in 3 months, but customer adoption was disappointing — only 8% of customers created accounts. We did not invest enough in understanding whether our specific customer base actually wanted self-service before building.
answers.strategicGoals: Customer retention has declined from 92% to 84% over the past 18 months, primarily among our mid-tier and enterprise segments. Exit interviews consistently cite product stagnation and poor digital self-service tools as reasons for leaving. We need to urgently modernize our customer-facing technology and proactively address the specific pain points driving churn before the trend becomes irreversible.
answers.additionalContext: We completed a merger with a similarly-sized competitor 4 months ago and are in the middle of integrating teams, systems, and processes. The combined organization has significant duplication — two CRMs, two HR systems, overlapping product lines. There is a unique window to redesign processes from scratch rather than patching legacy approaches, but cultural integration is fragile and change fatigue is real.

input.changes_since_last: Product launch successful — 3 new features shipped. Customer NPS improved 20 points. Backlog of technical debt growing.

opportunities.title: Operational Process Standardization and Compliance Mapping
opportunities.rationale: The recent merger created significant process duplication (2 CRMs, 2 HR systems) that poses a critical risk to compliance and efficiency. This opportunity evolves the prior focus by embedding regulatory mapping into the integration structure, ensuring the merged entity meets all high-risk regulatory requirements while streamlining core functions.

first_actions: Form a cross-functional Integration Task Force (ITF) with representatives from Legal and Compliance to map current processes against required regulations.
Define a 'To Be' state process model for critical areas (e.g., client onboarding, data handling, permitting) that eliminates redundancy.
Prioritize system consolidation based on regulatory necessity rather than departmental preference.
resources_needed: Temporary Budget Allocation for Integration Tools
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in identified process redundancies by 40% and completion of a Compliance Gap Analysis report.
milestones: Executive Sign-off on Consolidated Systems Roadmap (Month 3)

opportunities.title: Customer Journey Mapping and Digital Retention Audit
opportunities.rationale: Given the decline in customer retention (84%) and explicit pain points citing poor self-service, a deep audit is needed. This goes beyond simple tech fixes to map the full customer journey against regulatory touchpoints and operational bottlenecks, focusing on proactive interventions.

first_actions: Conduct ethnographic interviews with churned mid-tier/enterprise customers (qualitative data collection).
Map the current state of the customer lifecycle, identifying all points where regulatory compliance checks or manual intervention occurs.
Prioritize technology gaps that directly impact the user experience and service continuity.
execution_plan.success_metric: Completion of a 'High-Impact Pain Point' prioritized backlog, tied to 3 measurable retention KPIs.
milestones: Initial Journey Map Drafted and Validated (Month 2)
Executive Steering Committee Approval for Tech Upgrade Scope (Month 3)

next_steps.action: Formally charter the Operational Integration Task Force (ITF) and secure dedicated executive sponsorship to accelerate process standardization.
Initiate a mandatory, high-level training module for all merged staff on the updated compliance requirements related to data handling and real estate law.
Allocate budget (even if small initially) for dedicated process documentation tools to move away from the 'multiple hats' informal model.

key_weaknesses: Organizational instability and fragile cultural integration following the recent merger.
Extreme reliance on informal, undocumented processes ('tribal knowledge') leading to compliance risk and inefficiency.
Lack of dedicated funding mechanism for innovation or strategic operational debt reduction.

improvements: Successful product launch with 3 new features shipped.
NPS improved by 20 points, indicating better immediate customer satisfaction.
Some progress achieved in system documentation (opp_1 is completed).
persistent_gaps: Severe structural complexity due to merger integration and duplicated systems.
Customer retention rate remains critically low at 84%, signaling systemic service/product failures.
The lack of a formal customer feedback loop prevents proactive remediation.
achieved_milestones: Completion of initial documentation for key processes (opp_1)
Improved product feature set and immediate user satisfaction measures.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Significant organizational upheaval due to merger integration and continued digital/process debt despite product improvements. Focus shifted heavily from general improvement to core compliance stabilization.
